function: MIMO uplink channel estimation: recovering the channel matrix H from noisy pilots Y with a diffusion denoiser in the angular domain (p. 1-2).
system: 5G NR uplink massive MIMO: UE with 64 transmit antennas (Nt), BS with 16 receive antennas (Nr), 40 GHz, 15.36 MHz sampling rate; no RIS (p. 1, 4).
method: DDIM-based CNN encoder-decoder denoiser with an antenna modifier module conditioned on antenna spacing; L2 noise-prediction training on simulated channels; modified 3-step posterior sampling (p. 2-4).
data_channel: Own CDL-C (NLOS) and CDL-D (LOS) datasets of 3GPP TR 38.901 at 40 GHz, mixed antenna spacings 0.4-1.3 lambda; 8000 training, 1000 validation, 1000 test samples (p. 4).
test_conditions: Training and test on the same CDL dataset type (8000/1000/1000 split, mixed antenna spacings with label); SNR swept from -10 to 30 dB; no unseen spacing, array or channel model (p. 4).
baselines: Non-learned: LS, Scov, LMMSE; learned: DDPM and DDIM of [11], DMCE [13], score-based network [12] (p. 4).
metrics: NMSE versus SNR (-10 to 30 dB) in CDL-C and CDL-D channels; NMSE ablation of the sampling strategy and the antenna modifier module (p. 4-5).
complexity: Table I: parameter count per module, total 5 x 10^6 parameters; 3 reverse sampling steps with skipped timesteps; no FLOPs or runtime reported (p. 3-4).
q1_support: p. 4: "We generate two datasets, namely, CDL-C and CDL-D datasets" for training and test; Table II (p. 4, an image) gives the channel model as CDL-C/CDL-D of 3GPP TR 38.901 at 40 GHz.
q2_support: p. 4: "we mix the different antenna spacing into dataset with label" and the test set is part of the same dataset ("8000 training samples, 1000 validation samples, and 1000 test samples"); only SNR is swept. No unseen spacing, array size or channel model is tested.
q3_support: p. 4: "We compare our method with LS, Scov, DMCE" and "DDPM and DDIM methods are introduced from [11]", all "using NMSE as the evaluation metric"; LS and Scov/LMMSE are non-learned, DDIM/DDPM, DMCE and the score-based network are earlier learned estimators.
q4_support: p. 3: "Table I summarizes the network architecture and there parameters"; Table I gives the parameter count of each module and a total of 5 x 10^6 parameters, a quantitative cost of the proposed network.
q5_support: p. 4: "We generate two datasets, namely, CDL-C and CDL-D datasets". The data are self-generated; no code or data link, DOI, public dataset or measured data appears anywhere in the paper.
notes: Included, area 2 (channel estimation in uplink massive MIMO; IRS is only cited as an application in the introduction, p. 1). Tables I and II and Figs. 4-6 are images, read from PDF pages 3-5. Text gives 8000/1000/1000 samples (p. 4) while Table II lists 3000 realizations. The paper claims one model generalizes across antenna spacings (p. 3), but all spacings are mixed in training (p. 4).
